publishDialog.title: Publish this agent?
publishDialog.body: Publishing makes this version available at your public Stack32 link.

empty.title: Describe the agent you need
empty.subtitle: One clear sentence is enough. Stack32 will build a first version, test it, and let you try it right away.

actions.fixAutomaticallyHint: Click to let Stack32 repair what it found.
actions.fixPromptEmpty: Something still needs a quick fix before the agent is ready.
actions.problemsDetectedFallback: Stack32 found something to adjust before your agent is ready.

mock.successResponse: Your agent is ready to try. I set its goal, chose the right abilities, and ran a first test. Everything looks good. Open Live to talk to it, or Structure to see how it works.
mock.warningResponse: Your agent is built, but the test found a small issue: one answer was a bit unclear. You can try it as is, or let me fix it.
mock.errorResponse: I couldn't finish this build. The test failed while checking answers. I can fix it for you, or you can rephrase your request with a bit more detail.
mock.repairResponse: All set. I adjusted the instructions and ran the test again. Your agent is ready to use.
mock.executionDisabled: Building is temporarily unavailable. Your message was saved. We'll continue as soon as the service is back.

identity.prompt: Before I build your agent, tell me how it should introduce itself.
identity.name: Agent name
identity.confirmedNext: Next step: connect a brain (LLM) with your API key so the agent can actually think.

ready.title: First version ready
ready.success: Your agent is ready to try. I wrote its instructions, unlocked abilities and memory, built the structure, and passed a quick test. Open Live to chat with it, or keep improving it here.
ready.builtSuccess: Your agent is built. Configure the model, connections, and secrets in AI Agent before using it.
ready.setupInAiAgent: Model setup and connections happen in AI Agent.
ready.llmKeyRequired: Add your LLM API key before testing Live.

modify.success: Done. I applied your change and updated the agent. Keep chatting here to refine it, or open Structure to inspect what changed.
modify.warning: I applied your changes, but the quick test found a small issue. We can fix it, or you can keep iterating here.

secrets.prompt:
For your agent to think, connect a brain (LLM) with Pipedream.

Pick a provider, connect your account, then continue. Stack32 never stores your API key.
secrets.saved:
Saved.

Your LLM connection is in place.
secrets.secureNotice: Your key is encrypted and used only to power this agent.
secrets.pipedreamNotice: Connect your LLM provider with Pipedream. Stack32 uses that account securely — you never paste an API key here.
secrets.byokHint: Paste your key. You can show or hide it while typing. We only keep a short masked hint.

capabilities.prompt:
How should this agent start?

Chat is always on. You can also add a schedule, or a tool event (Gmail, Sheets, Slack…).
capabilities.promptAfterSecret:
Key saved — thank you.

How should this agent start?

Chat is always on. Optionally add a schedule or a tool event below.
capabilities.hint: Choose how this agent is triggered. Chat cannot be turned off.
capabilities.saved:
Got it.

I'm building the first version now. This can take a moment.
capabilities.triggerChatHint: Anyone can talk to the agent in Live. Always included.
capabilities.scheduleHourlyHint: Adds an automatic hourly run when scheduling is available.
capabilities.toolTriggerHint: Starts the agent when an app event arrives (new email, new row, message…).
capabilities.toolTriggerEmpty: No events found for this tool
capabilities.toolTriggerRequired: Choose a tool, then the event that should start the agent.

providers.prompt: To wire the right tool, pick the app you actually use (Gmail, Stripe, HubSpot…). You can also paste the website URL. No account linking yet.
providers.promptEmail: I’ll help you connect email. Choose your mailbox (Gmail, Outlook…). No account linking yet.
providers.promptCrm: I’ll help you connect your CRM. Pick the one you use (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive…). No account linking yet.
providers.promptAmbiguous: Several apps match what you mentioned. Pick the right one — or paste the website URL. No account linking yet.
providers.saved: Got it — I'll wire those apps into your agent definition.
